item.title: Constitution Day - September 17th
item.description: Constitution Day commemorates the formation and signing of the U.S. Constitution on September 17, 1787. In honor of Constitution Day and Citizenship Day, the SUSLA Office of Financial Aid & Scholarships has assembled a variety of educational information and resources to help the Southern University at Shreveport community learn, participate, and reflect on the Constitution and its continuing role in American civic life. Happy Constitution Day! Federal law requires educational institutions receiving federal funding to provide an educational program about the United States Constitution for students on or around September 17th annually. Constitution Day provides an opportunity for students, faculty, and staff to learn more about the Constitution, citizenship, civic responsibility, and the structure of the federal government. NATIONAL ARCHIVES LOUISIANA SECRETARY OF STATE
